notes: Cats: Spain in both banks, which hold the Catalan stems (twelve Régionale, five Village); the Cava, llicorella, Priorat ladder and producer stems that sit under Sparkling/Fortified/Sweet, Soil & Terroir, Producers & Icons and Classifications & Labels are listed in the review and left out because those categories carry the world (the Village Sparkling Wine World category holds no Cava stem at all). Chapters: the Régionale catalonia chapter and the Village Spain chapter (facts 6 and 8, traps 2 and 3). Regions: penedes for Cava and DO Penedès, priorat for Priorat, the two articles REGIONS.join.cats files under catalonia. Country: spain for the DOCa rung and Tempranillo's Catalan name. Grapes: Garnacha and Cariñena (Carignan) for Priorat, Chardonnay and Pinot Noir for the international grapes the Court names for Cava; Xarel-lo, Parellada, Macabeo and Garnacha Blanca have no grape record, and Priorat's Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah are left to the article. Techniques: traditional-method (the roster's must-link for penedes), steep-slopes for Priorat's terraces, oak for the French oak the Court names in Priorat's winemaking and pairing cells. No service table: the Court's page has no service cell.
